g.text: Filled circles: UN and FA average effects. Open diamond: interaction effect (UN + FA, 11 vs. 00); grey tick: UN alone + FA alone.
Intervals: unadjusted 95% cluster bootstrap (139 items, 91 clusters, 10,000 draws).
